'''Coconut's Love Waltz (Part 2)''' (Japanese: '''ココナッツのラブ・ウォーズ (後編)''' ''Coconut's Love Wars (Part 2)'') is the sixty-fourth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Kiaraway]] is such a cad -- how dare he kiss [[Coconut]] on the lips so soon after meeting?! In her frustration, will she be able to successfully complete her experiment, or will she be packing her bags?
